mostWorthwhile.text: The ending’s handoff of the preserved specimens gives the discovery a satisfying destination, while leaving its scientific meaning open.

leastWorthwhile.text: Chapter 36 has no playable decisions, so there was no action to evaluate in this chapter.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the docking and specimen handoff follow naturally from the supplied history.

arbitrary.text: No action in this chapter felt arbitrary; there were no actions to take.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see what the laboratories discover, although this ending provides no gameplay on which to judge a further chapter.
